meta.sourcing_rules: Dates are only recorded from a region-specific source (the firm's own regional posting or careers page stating London). date_confidence: 'confirmed' = regional page/posting states this cycle explicitly; 'indicative' = regional source but rolling/prior-cycle/no year stated, or found via a search-engine summary of the regional posting rather than a direct fetch; 'unconfirmed' = no regional source seen yet, date fields left empty. Never alert on unconfirmed dates. Foreign-market (non-UK) dates are marked not_applicable rather than recorded.
meta.environment_notes: This run had no access to WebFetch against company/careers domains (blocked by the sandbox's egress proxy) and no Claude in Chrome/Edge browser extension (not available in this cloud session). Discovery relied on the Indeed connector (best source this run: real, dated, primary-sourced UK postings) plus WebSearch summaries of firm career pages (treated as 'indicative' unless the search result directly quoted primary posting text). ZipRecruiter is US/Canada-only per its own tool description and returned nothing usable for London. Dice returned no relevant matches. If a future run gains real WebFetch/browser access to career portals, re-verify 'indicative'/'Watch' entries and upgrade their date_confidence.
